intentAndPurpose.intent: Loading-placeholder primitives. `SkeletonItem` resolves size from explicit width/height, else infers it from children (measured, not painted), else a token fallback box (never 0×0). `SkeletonGroup` wraps SkeletonItem children and staggers each one's shimmer automatically (delay = index × Motion-Offset-L). Single fixed shimmer (colour change), static under reduce-motion. The item is decorative (aria-hidden); the group is the announced loading region.

props.name: width
props.description: SkeletonItem: explicit width (px number or "%"). When set, children are ignored for sizing. RN honours numbers and percentages only.

props.name: height
props.description: SkeletonItem: explicit height (px number or "%"). When set, children are ignored for sizing.

props.name: children
props.description: SkeletonItem: content used for natural-size inference when width/height are omitted (laid out but not painted). SkeletonGroup: the direct SkeletonItem children to stagger.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: SkeletonGroup: label for the loading region. Default: "Loading".
